expected.name: rrn
expected.description: The report reference number as published where not empty, NULL where empty (9% of rows, mostly 2013 to 2016). Unique where present.

expected.name: uprn_sepcr
expected.description: The register's own 10-digit property reference, trimmed and as an integer. Not the Gazetteer UPRN. Present in every row.

expected.name: uprn_osg
expected.description: The One Scotland Gazetteer UPRN as an integer, NULL where the published cell is empty (4.7% of rows). The only column a join compares; a padded cohort UPRN matches once cast to bigint.

expected.name: pc_norm
expected.description: POSTCODE upper-cased with every space removed, postcode-simd's pc_norm. NULL where the published cell is empty. Nothing repaired.

expected.name: datazone_2001
expected.description: The 2001 data zone code when DATA_ZONE starts with S01 and six digits followed by a space or the end, otherwise NULL.

expected.name: datazone_2001_status
expected.description: code, empty, not_a_datazone (for 00Q, NA and the like) or unknown_code (well formed, not in the pinned list; the build fails if any).

expected.name: datazone_2011
expected.description: The 2011 data zone code by the same rule, otherwise NULL.

expected.name: datazone_2011_status
expected.description: As datazone_2001_status, for the 2011 column.

expected.name: inspection_date_parsed
expected.description: INSPECTION_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date: the day the assessor saw the dwelling. The dated joins choose the certificate by it. A value that does not parse stops the build.

expected.name: lodgement_date_parsed
expected.description: LODGEMENT_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date. The administrative date of the certificate, the same day as the inspection or soon after (median 1 day); the ten-year validity runs from it. Outliers (2002, 2006, 2108) are kept as published.

expected.name: created_at_parsed
expected.description: CREATED_AT (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss) as a timestamp to the second. Its year is the file year.

expected.name: historic_flag
expected.description: 1 where HISTORIC is True (the certificate has been superseded), 0 where False. Any other value stops the build.

expected.name: current_energy_efficiency_int
expected.description: The current energy efficiency rating as an integer. A SAP rating runs 1 to 100; values above 100 are publisher errors kept as published and counted in the build report.

expected.name: potential_energy_efficiency_int
expected.description: The potential energy efficiency rating as an integer.

expected.name: environment_impact_current_int
expected.description: The current environmental impact rating as an integer.

expected.name: environment_impact_potential_int
expected.description: The potential environmental impact rating as an integer.

expected.name: total_floor_area_int
expected.description: Total floor area in square metres as an integer. 0 in every 2008 and 2009 row.

actual.name: rrn
actual.description: The report reference number as published where not empty, NULL where empty (9% of rows, mostly 2013 to 2016). Unique where present.

actual.name: uprn_sepcr
actual.description: The register's own 10-digit property reference, trimmed and as an integer. Not the Gazetteer UPRN. Present in every row.

actual.name: uprn_osg
actual.description: The One Scotland Gazetteer UPRN as an integer, NULL where the published cell is empty (4.7% of rows). The only column a join compares; a padded cohort UPRN matches once cast to bigint.

actual.name: pc_norm
actual.description: POSTCODE upper-cased with every space removed, postcode-simd's pc_norm. NULL where the published cell is empty. Nothing repaired.

actual.name: datazone_2001
actual.description: The 2001 data zone code when DATA_ZONE starts with S01 and six digits followed by a space or the end, otherwise NULL.

actual.name: datazone_2001_status
actual.description: code, empty, not_a_datazone (for 00Q, NA and the like) or unknown_code (well formed, not in the pinned list; the build fails if any).

actual.name: datazone_2011
actual.description: The 2011 data zone code by the same rule, otherwise NULL.

actual.name: datazone_2011_status
actual.description: As datazone_2001_status, for the 2011 column.

actual.name: inspection_date_parsed
actual.description: INSPECTION_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date: the day the assessor saw the dwelling. The dated joins choose the certificate by it. A value that does not parse stops the build.

actual.name: lodgement_date_parsed
actual.description: LODGEMENT_DATE (yyyy-mm-dd) as a date. The administrative date of the certificate, the same day as the inspection or soon after (median 1 day); the ten-year validity runs from it. Outliers (2002, 2006, 2108) are kept as published.

actual.name: created_at_parsed
actual.description: CREATED_AT (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss) as a timestamp to the second. Its year is the file year.

actual.name: historic_flag
actual.description: 1 where HISTORIC is True (the certificate has been superseded), 0 where False. Any other value stops the build.

actual.name: current_energy_efficiency_int
actual.description: The current energy efficiency rating as an integer. A SAP rating runs 1 to 100; values above 100 are publisher errors kept as published and counted in the build report.

actual.name: potential_energy_efficiency_int
actual.description: The potential energy efficiency rating as an integer.

actual.name: environment_impact_current_int
actual.description: The current environmental impact rating as an integer.

actual.name: environment_impact_potential_int
actual.description: The potential environmental impact rating as an integer.

actual.name: total_floor_area_int
actual.description: Total floor area in square metres as an integer. 0 in every 2008 and 2009 row.

actual.name: energy_consumption_current_num
actual.description: Primary energy indicator (kWh per square metre per year) as decimal(19,4).

actual.name: co2_emissions_current_num
actual.description: Current emissions (tonnes of CO2 per year) as decimal(19,4).

actual.name: co2_emiss_curr_per_floor_area_num
actual.description: Current emissions per floor area (kg of CO2 per square metre per year) as decimal(19,4).
